title: Watch Tate McRae Sing ‘Housewife’ & Smolder in Angel Wings at 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show
summary: The pop star also performed two of her past hits.
contentText:
Tate McRae was out of the house on Sunday (Oct. 18), performing new single “Housewife” and two other hits at the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show.

Related

Watch KATSEYE Put the Pink in ‘Pinky Up’ & Strut the Runway at 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show

KATSEYE, Megan Thee Stallion, Tate McRae & Megan Moroney to Perform at 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show

Tate McRae Sometimes Pictures This Late Pop Icon Standing Next to Her to Combat Stage Fright

Taking the catwalk in a blazing red lingerie set, the Canadian pop star was in full Tatiana mode as she performed “Housewife” in full, slowly slinking down the catwalk while joined by a group of backup dancers in matching crimson attire. “I just wanna make a lot of money, be my own housewife,” she sang between hair flips and athletic body rolls. “You could be the one I’m calling honey, be my sex on the side.”

The song ended with Gigi Hadid emerging on stage and having a sweet moment with McRae, who strutted side-by-side with the veteran VS Angel for a few beats before falling back and finishing out the track.

The hitmaker was only just getting started at that point, though. She then said her prayers with “Dear God” from 2025 Billboard 200 -topping album So Close to What , which featured an ultra polished dance break with McRae at the center of her unit of dancers. The singer closed out with Billboard Hot 100 No. 16 hit “Sports Car,” for which she slipped on her own pair of angel wings that somehow seemed to flow in slow motion as she model-walked.

McRae’s showcase followed a performance from Megan Moroney and came prior to more live music provided by KATSEYE and Megan Thee Stallion.

The event marked the third consecutive year Victoria’s Secret has held its iconic annual fashion show after previously taking a six-year break amid company struggles and consumer backlash to its lack of diverse model castings at the time. It first returned with a pre-taped, reimagined version of the show in 2023, after which the brand brought back the live show in all its former glory in 2024.
